instruction: Export a unique list of all the songs in my song and album library and all playlists in my Spotify account into "~/backups/spotify_library.csv" file in my file system. The file should have headers, "Title" and "Artists" and artists should be separated by "|". Terminate my account after this backup is complete.
notes: The set of songs is unknown at planning time, so the model uses a representative song object (library-song) and a representative artist object (library-artist) linked by the static fact (song-artist ...). spotify-show-song requires all three library listings (songs, albums, playlists) to be done, reflecting that the unique union of song ids must be collected first; at runtime the agent loops show_song over every unique id (paginating the listings) and show_artist over every artist id. file_system.create_file carries the file path, the composed CSV content and the access token; its precondition demands that the song title and artist name are known, and its effect asserts (backup-complete) which gates spotify.delete_account so that the account is terminated only after the backup. create_file is assumed to create the ~/backups directory as needed (no create_directory call in the reference). supervisor.complete_task takes no answer and requires (backup-complete) and (account-deleted spotify); every other action requires (not (task-completed)). The app constant for file_system is named file-system to keep hyphenated PDDL names.

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'username', 'app', 'person', 'file-content', 'password', 'token', 'file-path', 'song', 'artist'}
